question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'Red Earth and Pouring Rain: A Novel'?
solution:
The correct answer is **Vikram Chandra**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vikram Chandra** is a renowned Indian-American writer, whose work includes a blend of fiction and non-fiction, exploring themes of modern India, its politics, society, and complexities.
 
• The book **'Red Earth and Pouring Rain'** was published in 1995 and received critical acclaim for its unique narrative style, blending Indian mythological elements with contemporary life.
 
• This novel won the **1996 Commonwealth Writers' Prize** for Best First Book and the **David Higham Prize** for Fiction.
 
• The story is known for its intricate plot, involving a reincarnated poet who narrates tales spanning across centuries, reflecting on the nature of life, death, and redemption.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vikram Chandra** was born in New Delhi, India, in 1961 and has since lived and worked across the world, including in the United States where he teaches creative writing.
 
• He is also known for his other works such as **'Sacred Games'**, which was adapted into a successful Netflix series, showcasing his ability to intertwine crime, history, and spirituality in a narrative.
 
• Chandra's writing style is characterized by its deep engagement with the complexities of Indian culture, politics, and history, making his books both informative and deeply engaging.
 
• He has been a recipient of several awards and fellowships, including the **John Llewellyn Rhys Prize** and a **Fulbright Scholarship**.
